symptom: Under `mdl 1;` describe still wrote mdl 0 escapes (`\n`, `\r\n`, `\\`) for every string but a text template: TestApp WorkflowCommons.ASU_UserTaskView_Migrate's free annotation ends in CR LF, so its mdl 1 describe -> exec was refused (the annotation read back as a backslash, r, backslash, n). With that fixed, an unchanged mdl 1 description of a flow whose `change` sets a multi-line string (TestApp ACT_AuditTrailViewer_*) still rewrote the activity, and `fmt --upgrade --header` refused an escaped line break in any re-rendered expression.
cause: mdlQuote (≈80 describe sites) had no language parameter; #799 fixed only the three template sites with a local templateQuote. escapeExpressionValue escaped control characters in a stored expression's strings whatever the language. create or modify described its stored side as mdl 0 (#747) while the declared side was read under mdl 1, and the two spellings build different ASTs: `'…\n…'` is re-rendered, the same string written over lines is stored as written (SourceExpr), so declaredMatches saw a change. escapeFix could only requote a literal in place, which flips a re-rendered expression to stored-as-written.
insight: One quoting function keyed on describeLanguage (langver.Frozen is the only switch) and threaded ctx everywhere describe writes a string; every internal describe -> parse goes through describedSource so it is read under the header it was written in. A value compared as an AST is only comparable when both sides are read by the same language rules, so the diff pins describe to the script's version (describeIn) instead of a fixed one. The fmt rewrite for an expression replaces the whole expression by its Mendix rendering (the renderer moved to mdl/mendixexpr so the visitor can call it), which stored as written under mdl 1 is exactly what mdl 0 stored. Measured by round-tripping every PedApp/TestApp document whose mdl 0 description holds a backslash (44) under mdl 1; the allowlisted ones must lose exactly what they lose under mdl 0.
test: mdl/executor/describe_string_quoting_test.go; mdl/upgrade/gated_test.go (escaped line break in an expression); mdl/roundtrip/string_quoting_test.go (integration)
